tests.description: 三個GLB載入、旋轉、左右平移、拉近及1/2/3場景切換。
tests.name: LandmarkModelsAndCamera
tests.source: harness.setMaxScreenshots(3); for (const name of ['駱駝石','圓山八角亭','禱告山']) { await harness.goToScene(name); await harness.stepFrames(5); const objs=harness.getObjects('Landmark'); harness.assert(objs.length===1,name+' has one native model'); const b=harness.getRenderedBounds(objs[0].id); harness.assert(b && b.maxZ-b.minZ>1,name+' GLB renders after reopening'); console.log(name,b); await harness.takeScreenshot(name,{width:1000}); } await harness.goToScene('駱駝石'); await harness.stepFrames(3); const before=harness.getCameraState(''); harness.setKeyPressed('a',true); await harness.stepFrames(12); harness.releaseAllInputs(); const after=harness.getCameraState(''); harness.assert(Math.hypot(after.x-before.x,after.y-before.y)>0.1,'WASD pans camera'); harness.setMousePosition(1000,600,'UI'); harness.setMouseButtonPressed(true,'left'); await harness.stepFrames(2); const yaw=harness.getSceneVariable('Yaw').value; harness.setMousePosition(1250,650,'UI'); await harness.stepFrames(2); harness.releaseAllInputs(); await harness.stepFrames(1); harness.assert(Math.abs(harness.getSceneVariable('Yaw').value-yaw)>1,'Left drag rotates'); const x=harness.getSceneVariable('TargetX').value; harness.setMouseButtonPressed(true,'right'); await harness.stepFrames(2); harness.setMousePosition(1450,650,'UI'); await harness.stepFrames(2); harness.releaseAllInputs(); await harness.stepFrames(1); harness.assert(Math.abs(harness.getSceneVariable('TargetX').value-x)>0.1,'Right drag pans'); harness.setMousePosition(500,240,'UI'); harness.setMouseButtonPressed(true,'left'); await harness.stepFrames(2); const d=harness.getSceneVariable('Distance').value; harness.setMouseButtonPressed(false,'left'); await harness.stepFrames(2); harness.assert(harness.getSceneVariable('Distance').value<d,'Zoom button moves closer'); harness.setKeyPressed('Num2',true); await harness.stepFrames(2); harness.releaseAllInputs(); await harness.stepFrames(2); harness.assert(harness.getSceneName()==='圓山八角亭','2 switches to pavilion'); harness.setKeyPressed('Num3',true); await harness.stepFrames(2); harness.releaseAllInputs(); await harness.stepFrames(2); harness.assert(harness.getSceneName()==='禱告山','3 switches to prayer hill'); harness.setKeyPressed('Num1',true); await harness.stepFrames(2); harness.releaseAllInputs(); await harness.stepFrames(2); harness.assert(harness.getSceneName()==='駱駝石','1 switches to camel rock'); harness.setKeyPressed('Home',true); await harness.stepFrames(2); harness.releaseAllInputs(); harness.assert(harness.getSceneVariable('Distance').value===36,'Home resets model view');

events.comment:
At each frame, the camera must catchup the target by a given ratio (speed)
cameraX(t) - targetX = (cameraX(t - 1) - targetX) * (1 - speed)

The frame rate must not impact on the catch-up speed, we don't want a speed in ratio per frame but a speed ratio per second, like this:
cameraX(t) - targetX = (cameraX(t - 1s) - targetX) * (1 - speed)

Ok, but we still need to process each frame, we can use a exponent for this:
cameraX(t) - targetX = (cameraX(t - timeDelta) - targetX) * (1 - speed)^timeDelta
cameraX(t) = targetX + (cameraX(t - timeDelta) - targetX) * exp(timeDelta * ln((1 - speed)))

pow is probably more efficient than precalculated log if the speed is changed continuously but this might be rare enough.

parameters: TargetedRotationAngle + 90 + RotationAngleOffset + AngleDifference(CameraAngle(Object.Layer()), TargetedRotationAngle + 90 + RotationAngleOffset) * exp(TimeDelta() * RotationLogSpeed)
TargetedElevationAngle + ElevationAngleOffset + AngleDifference(90 - Scene3D::CameraRotationX(Object.Layer()), TargetedElevationAngle + ElevationAngleOffset) * exp(TimeDelta() * ElevationLogSpeed)
